result.summary: The image depicts a wide urban intersection with high-rise commercial buildings and significant vehicle traffic. While the environment includes essential pedestrian infrastructure like marked zebra crosswalks, signals, and curb ramps, the multi-lane roadway creates a substantial crossing distance without a refuge island.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four lanes of traffic in a single stage without a refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground, across the main roadway

hazards.name: High Traffic Volume
hazards.description: Multiple lanes of active vehicle traffic increase the risk of conflict during crossing maneuvers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles receive a green light.

result.summary: The image depicts a wide urban thoroughfare with significant pedestrian activity but a complete absence of formal crossing infrastructure.
